title: printer
description: You see your trusty Epson MX-80 printer.
details: The Epson MX-80 sits on the desk. Reliable. Loud. Compact.

It uses the same kind of ink ribbon you'd find in an old typewriter. Its 9-pin print head has hammered out mountains of source code, copied manuals, late-night notes, and enough continuous-feed paper to wallpaper this apartment.
Sure, the MX-80 can print crude black-and-white graphics if you insist. But the real magic is the fast text mode.
takeFailure: That would require either remarkable dedication to portable computing or a very specific kind of mental collapse.
